_comment: Exact allow-list for load-reachable risky-global references in the audited route prefix.
Pinned to `prefix_sha256`: if the prefix changes at all, scan-toplevel-danger.js rejects
this whole file rather than carrying stale approvals forward. Entries that match nothing
are also a hard failure, so a removed source site cannot leave a rotting approval behind.
Only references that guard analysis CANNOT prove inert belong here. References dominated
by a real `typeof X === "undefined"` test are proved automatically and must NOT be listed
(the six storage-migration `localStorage` reads at prefix lines 38817-38861 are in that
Every `reason` below was re-read from route-oracle/out/route-prefix.js during M3.3.
Line numbers are 1-based lines of the PREFIX, not of the full bundle.

reason_codes.inert-dom-stub-listener: A `document.addEventListener(...)` registration. run-scenario.js's `makeDom()` gives the document object a no-op `addEventListener`, so the handler is never even stored, never mind dispatched. The driver dispatches no events at the document level; it only invokes listeners the source attached to specific ELEMENTS it also created.
reason_codes.inert-dom-stub-read: A read of `document.documentElement` / `document.getElementById(...)` that only decides a presentation attribute. The stub returns inert elements whose style/class writes go nowhere.
reason_codes.audited-try-catch-inert-when-absent: Lexically inside a `try { ... } catch { }` whose handler swallows. With the global left undefined on the sandbox the very first reference throws a ReferenceError, the empty catch absorbs it, and the enclosing IIFE returns without side effects. Verified by reading the block, not inferred from the presence of a try.

entries.name: document
entries.note: Fullscreen-button visibility IIFE: reads document.documentElement, finds no requestFullscreen on the stub, and hides #btn-fullscreen. Presentation only.

entries.name: document
entries.note: Same IIFE: document.getElementById("btn-fullscreen") followed by a style write.

entries.name: document
entries.note: document.addEventListener("pointerdown", ..., {capture,passive}) -- the UI click-sound rig. FOUND IN M3.3: this sits OUTSIDE the 63600-63900 window the previous scanner hard-coded as 'the audited DOM wiring', and the previous scanner waved it through only because it was inside an IIFE.

entries.name: document
entries.note: document.addEventListener("pointerover", ..., {capture,passive}) -- hover-sound rig, same IIFE, same M3.3 finding.

entries.name: localStorage
entries.note: `for (const B of Object.keys(localStorage))` -- the cached-Pokemon schema sweep. localStorage is undefined on the sandbox, so Object.keys(localStorage) throws immediately into the empty catch and the IIFE ends. NOT typeof-guarded: the previous scanner's success message claimed every remaining IIFE hit was `typeof`-gated, which was false about exactly this site.

entries.name: localStorage
entries.note: `localStorage.removeItem(B)` in the body of the same swept loop; unreachable because the loop header above already threw.
